entries.title: Scheduled probe lacks service secret
entries.root_cause: The scheduled workflow uses a job without the observatory environment, where the BEACON_PROBE_KEY secret is configured, so the secret resolves to an empty string. Attach the job to that environment.

entries.title: Beacon window boundary assertion fails
entries.root_cause: The upper-boundary test expects true but receives false. The log does not establish whether the calculation or the expectation is incorrect.

entries.title: Probe secret reference uses the wrong name
entries.root_cause: The workflow refers to BEACON_PROBE_TOKEN, which is absent from the repository and observatory environment; the environment contains BEACON_PROBE_KEY. Update the workflow secret reference.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Like e1, the probe receives an empty credential, but this manually dispatched job selects the environment and references a different secret name.

entries.title: Scheduled probe again lacks service secret
entries.root_cause: The scheduled workflow uses a job without the observatory environment, where the BEACON_PROBE_KEY secret is configured, so the secret resolves to an empty string. Attach the job to that environment.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later scheduled run uses a newer runner image and reaches the probe through an npm script; the job still omits the environment.
